work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Declaration on the Relation of the Church to Non-Christian Religions, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 28 October 1965. Its numbered articles 1-5 address humanity's common origin and end, the Church's relation to non-Christian religions, Muslims, the Jewish people, antisemitism, and discrimination.
